In this experiment, you will investigate how the surface of a container affects the rate at which
water cools.
Two test-tubes, labelled A and B, have been set up for you. Test-tube A has no covering.
Test-tube B is covered with foil. Each test-tube has a mark to show the required water level.
Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 2.1.
